title: Blackjaw, the Remnant Boss Guide: Act 3 Optional Fight, Triple Slam and Permanent Fire Resistance Reward
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 3 optional boss guide: Jiquani's Machinarium route, the permanent +10% fire resistance reward (The Flame Core), Triple Slam timing, and Red Flash attacks.
description: Beat Blackjaw, the Remnant in PoE2 Act 3. Why he is worth farming, Machinarium route, permanent reward, Triple Slam rhythms, fire/physical prep, and troubleshooting the no-turn-back path.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Blackjaw, the Remnant — Act 3 optional boss art

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Stay CLOSE to Blackjaw and dodge BEHIND him — his Shockwave Slam Combo and Hellfire Combo have range, speed and tracking that punish distance. The reward (The Flame Core) permanently grants +10% Fire Resistance.
calloutDetail: Blackjaw is an Act 3 optional boss in Jiquani's Machinarium. He is a physical/fire brute; physical and fire resistance help but the real answer is learning his combos.
Defeating him yields The Flame Core, a consumable that permanently increases your Fire Resistance by +10% — a permanent account-style reward worth returning for.

sections.title: Top search questions: entry, materials, failure cost

items.question: What is the exact location and prerequisite route?
answer: He is in Jiquani's Machinarium in Act 3. Progress the Act 3 quest far enough to reach the Machinarium, then engage him in his arena.
The arena door, once passed, does not let you return the way you came — clear trash and commit.

items.question: What does the first kill reward, and is it different in Cruel/later versions?
answer: The first kill grants The Flame Core, a permanent +10% Fire Resistance consumable. Later difficulties/leagues keep the same permanent reward structure; the fight difficulty scales but the reward intent is unchanged.

items.question: What is the rhythm of each Triple Slam hit and the correct roll direction?
answer: Each slam in the triple has a clear wind-up; roll perpendicular/behind after each tells. The Shockwave Slam Combo in phase 2 adds range and tracking — roll behind him, not away.

items.question: Which attacks are Red Flash (telegraphed high damage)?
answer: Red Flash attacks are his biggest hits (Shockwave Slam Combo, Hellfire Combo fireballs). They flash red before impact — that is your cue to dodge behind him.

items.question: What if I leave and the door won't let me back / Soul Core route breaks?
answer: The Machinarium path is one-way once committed. If you leave, re-enter from the quest checkpoint; don't expect the door to reopen. Plan your consumables before engaging.

items.question: Is the Campaign version separate from a Map replica?
answer: Yes — this is the Campaign (Act 3) version. A Map-replica version may exist separately; this page covers the campaign fight and its permanent reward.

steps.label: Reach Jiquani's Machinarium
body: Progress Act 3 until you can enter Jiquani's Machinarium. The boss arena is inside.

steps.label: Engage in his arena
body: Enter the arena; the path behind seals. Clear trash and commit to the fight.

sections.title: Progression Unlock
paragraphs: Blackjaw's defining payoff is The Flame Core, dropped on first kill, which permanently increases your Fire Resistance by +10%. This is a permanent reward — worth returning for even if you out-level the fight.
Because it is permanent, the incentive is 'why you should go back and fight him' rather than raw loot. Later difficulties keep the same permanent reward intent; only fight scaling changes.
bullets: The Flame Core = permanent +10% Fire Resistance.
Worth farming even at higher level.
Campaign version; Map replica is separate.

items.label: Fire Resistance
items.why: Hellfire Combo and fireballs deal fire; the reward is fire res for a reason.
items.fix: Fire-crafted gear, Ruby Charm, or Purity of Fire.

items.label: Physical Resistance / Armour
items.why: He is a physical brute; slams hit hard.

items.label: Movement speed
items.why: His combos have tracking; mobility helps disengage.

items.label: Learn the combos
items.why: Distance play fails in phase 2; you must close and dodge behind.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Brute (100%–75%)
notes: Blackjaw is a physical brute. Staying close and dodging behind him works until he gains range attacks.
At ~75% HP he begins the Shockwave Slam Combo.

phases.label: Phase 2 — Shockwave & Hellfire (75%–0%)
notes: Shockwave Slam Combo gains range/speed/tracking — punish at close range by rolling behind. At ~50% the Hellfire Combo breathes a fire ring then a 5-swing flaming axe combo.
Seek refuge behind a pillar during fireballs, then close back in before the next Shockwave.
objectives: Dodge Shockwave Slam Combo behind him.

attacks.name: Triple Slam
responses: Roll perpendicular/behind after each tell; don't panic-roll early.
notes: Each slam is telegraphed; rhythm matters.
commonMistakes: Early panic roll into the next slam.

attacks.name: Shockwave Slam Combo (phase 2)
telegraph: Red Flash before a shockwave slam.
responses: Roll BEHIND him, not away — it has range and tracking.
notes: The deadliest phase-2 attack; distance fails.

attacks.name: Hellfire Combo (phase 2, ~50%)
telegraph: Breathes a fire ring, then 5-swing flaming axe combo with fireballs.
responses: Hide behind a pillar during fireballs, then close in before the next Shockwave.
notes: Fire ring wards you off; fireballs punish.

attacks.name: Leap Slam
responses: Dodge-roll out of the landing radius.

sections.title: Arena Reading
paragraphs: The Machinarium arena has pillars you can use during the Hellfire Combo — hide behind one for the fireballs, then close back in. The arena is otherwise open, and the path behind you seals once you commit, so clear trash first.
Stay close to Blackjaw; the open space punishes distance because his phase-2 combos have range and tracking.
bullets: Use pillars to break Hellfire fireballs.
Stay close; distance fails in phase 2.
Path seals behind you — clear trash first.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Fire and physical resistance help, but neither is decisive — his combos are the real test. Stay close, learn the roll-behind timing, and use pillars for the Hellfire fireballs. Low-movement and minion builds struggle because his tracking punishes standing still.
The fight is short; burst during his recovery windows.
bullets: Melee: glue to him, roll behind on Red Flash.
Ranged: harder — phase 2 tracking punishes distance.
Minion: body-block helps but watch tracking.
Fire + physical res, then learn the combos.

entries.question: How do I survive the Hellfire Combo?
summary: Players found hiding behind a pillar during the fireballs, then closing in, is the reliable pattern.
editorialAnalysis: We confirm the pillar refuge + re-close timing avoids the fireball punishment.
officialAnswer: Hide behind a pillar for the fireballs, then close in before the next Shockwave.

entries.question: Why can't I go back / route broke?
summary: Forum posts note the Machinarium path is one-way once committed.
editorialAnalysis: Our note: re-enter from the quest checkpoint; the door won't reopen.
officialAnswer: Path is one-way; re-enter from checkpoint and plan consumables first.

problems.symptom: The path sealed and I can't return
directAnswer: The Machinarium path is one-way once committed. Re-enter from the quest checkpoint; plan consumables before engaging.
